WHAT: Gallery cleanup app with Tinder-style swipe UX. Swipe left=delete, right=keep, up=favorite. Local only, no uploads.
TECH STACK: Swift 5.9+ / SwiftUI 5.0, Photos framework (PHAsset), StoreKit 2, Firebase Analytics + FCM, Google AdMob, Core Data/UserDefaults
MONETIZATION: Free (200 items/day + ads), Premium $4.99/mo or $29.99/yr or $9.99 lifetime
FILTERS (premium): screenshots, large videos >50MB, blurry, date range
IOS 26 SPECIFICS: .glassEffect() modifier, GlassEffectContainer for action buttons, Transaction.currentEntitlements(for:) for StoreKit, PHAsset.contentType UTType (replaces uniformTypeIdentifier), Firebase SDK 11.14+ required
ARCHITECTURE: SwipeClean/ → Models, Views, ViewModels, Managers, Extensions, Services. ~6.5k LOC total
TIMELINE: 2-3 weeks solo MVP
STITCH MOCKUPS: 5 screens generated — Main Swipe, Onboarding, Paywall, Session Complete, Filter Selection. Dark theme, Liquid Glass, gamified dopamine UX.
